## Must not say (binding for the script)

- Any real caller's name, handle or likeness ([named person], [named person]), or exact figures that identify their cases ($9.99M, 777 calls, 73%, 9q8zt)
- 'Pump.fun is a scam / rigged casino', or 'a judge found Pump.fun...' (the claims were only allowed to proceed)
- 'Bubblemaps proved / exposed / caught' (say 'alleged' or 'estimated')
- 'Graduated' or 'LP burned' means safe
- Any income promise or aspirational payout figure ('you'll earn...', 'top callers make six figures')
- Do not say the demo token fell 20% or that the theft was $106K. Use about 15% and about $100K.
- Exact current fee percentages attributed to the official fee page (not verified)

## Defamation risks

- None in this fixture.
